answer_1.quote: ...We show that a simple unified neural model trained on the high-quality dataset can approach human performance... The model is implemented as a Transformer-based language model like GPT2 and generates chatbot responses.

answer_2.quote: ...We report the perplexity, BLEU scores and distinct uni/bigrams for three model sizes... We also report hit@1 and hit@5 for knowledge retrieval.

answer_4.quote: ...We further conduct a set of static and interactive human evaluations... We focus on evaluate the machine-generated response from four perspectives: Sensibleness, Engagement, Factuality, Informativeness... evaluated by 3 workers each.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators rate each response on Sensibleness, Engagement, Factuality and Informativeness (binary votes).
